no-restricted-syntax.message: User-visible attribute copy must come from next-intl: use placeholder={t("…")}, not placeholder="…".
User-visible attribute copy must come from next-intl: use placeholder={t("…")}, not placeholder={"…"}.

toISOString() renders in UTC, so it is the wrong way to get a calendar date: east of Greenwich it reads yesterday for the first hours of every day, west of it tomorrow for the last. Use todayIso(), toLocalIsoDate(date) or fromLocalIsoDate(s) from @/lib/format for dates, and nowIso() for a timestamp. See issue #30.
